descriptionMarkdown:
Master-crafted gear is not an ordinary shopping upgrade. It is normally Rare or Exceptional, comes from a named 
maker or institution, and should matter enough that losing it hurts. A master-crafted item has one Masterwork Trait. 
Particularly important relic-grade items may have a second trait at the GM's discretion. Bonuses from duplicate 
Masterwork Traits never stack.
Masterwork Trait Eligible Item Effect
Perfect Balance Melee or ranged weapon Gain +1 to attack rolls made with the item.
Artificer Edge Melee weapon Once per turn when you roll weapon damage, reroll one damage die and 
use the new result.
Precision Barrel / Focusing 
Array Ranged weapon Increase normal range by 25%. This does not increase maximum range 
beyond double the new normal range.
Rapid Feed Reload weapon Increase Reload by 50%, rounded up. Does not stack with Extended 
Magazine.
Masterwork Trait Eligible Item Effect
Recoil Compensation Heavy ranged weapon Moving before firing no longer imposes a penalty from the Heavy 
property, though other Heavy restrictions still apply.
Compact Pattern Pistol, basic firearm or 
compact melee weapon
Advantage on checks to conceal the item; it can be readied from 
concealment without an item interaction once per turn.
Artificer Armour Armour Increase the armour's AC by +1. A shield or field cannot gain this trait.
Responsive Plating Armour Once per short rest, reduce damage from one non-critical weapon hit by 
your proficiency bonus.
Sealed Systems Armour
Gain advantage on saves against gas, smoke and airborne toxins. If the 
armour is already sealed, it also tolerates brief vacuum exposure without 
a separate suit breach test.
Bounded accuracy matters. The +1 attack or +1 AC traits above are intentionally powerful and should remain 
uncommon. They represent prized equipment, not a mandatory mathematical treadmill.
